core_obligations: Write Y = colim Y_lambda using the presentation of an affine formal algebraic space (proof lines 4181-4182).
For each lambda, obtain that the fibre product X x_Y Y_lambda is an algebraic space from representability of f (proof lines 4183-4184).
Identify X with the colimit of the X x_Y Y_lambda (proof lines 4184-4185).
Apply the colimit lemma to conclude that X is a formal algebraic space (proof lines 4185-4186).
proof_roadmap: Use the presentation of Y (proof lines 4181-4182).
Representable fibre products are algebraic spaces (proof lines 4183-4184).
difficulty_reason: For an affine formal algebraic space Y over S and a map of sheaves f : X -> Y representable by algebraic spaces, the lemma asserts that X is a formal algebraic space (statement lines 4172-4178). The proof writes Y as the colimit of the thickening terms Y_lambda supplied by the definition of an affine formal algebraic space, observes that each fibre product X x_Y Y_lambda is an algebraic space because f is representable, and then identifies X with the colimit of these algebraic spaces, which is a formal algebraic space by the chapter's colimit lemma (proof lines 4180-4186). The level is H2: both the reduction to the terms of the presentation and the colimit identification are displayed, with the representability hypothesis used at one clearly identifiable place.
